Name: Extra Seb Scene for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Permissions were open to edit Giosaurus's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1172]Newly added Sebastian cutscene[/url] as long as credit goes back to them, which of course it does! The original was an xnb mod and broken, so I thought I'd patch it up.

This mod adds an extra 8 heart event scene in Sebastian's room. Just have him at 8 hearts and enter his room. The original mod was marked as adult content but it's very PG so don't worry about that. It should also be compatible with other Seb mods.

Enjoy!
